meaning_en: #{id}: #{blocker} on {target_ref} is {state}: it may have been written. Nothing goes to this target until execute reconcile {blocker} reads it back
meaning_zh: #{id}：同一目标 {target_ref} 上的 #{blocker} 状态为 {state}，可能已经写入。在 execute reconcile {blocker} 回读确认之前，不会再向这个目标发送任何操作

meaning_en: #{id}: approved {decided_at}, older than {ttl_hours}h; approve it again after a fresh queue add
meaning_zh: #{id}：批准时间 {decided_at} 已超过 {ttl_hours} 小时；请重新加入队列后再批准

meaning_en: #{id}: the data it was approved on moved (basis {saved} is now {current}); a fresh queue add proposes it again
meaning_zh: #{id}：批准时依据的数据已经变了（依据 {saved} 现在是 {current}）；重新加入队列会再次提出

meaning_en: #{id}: deferred, this run already sends the most items allowed ({max})
meaning_zh: #{id}：推迟到下次执行，本次已达到单次最多 {max} 项

meaning_en: #{id}: no delta, so it cannot be proven within the run cap
meaning_zh: #{id}：没有变化量，无法证明在单次上限之内

meaning_en: #{id}: deferred, the run's total change would be {total} > {cap}
meaning_zh: #{id}：推迟到下次执行，本次总变化量会是 {total}，超过上限 {cap}

meaning_en: #{id} changed before it was sent; not sent
meaning_zh: #{id} 在发送前被改动了，未发送

meaning_en: dry run: {go} of {total} approved item(s) would be sent; nothing was written or called. --apply sends them
meaning_zh: 试运行：{total} 个已批准项中有 {go} 个会被发送；未写入也未调用任何接口。加 --apply 才会发送

meaning_en: dry run: {go} of {total} approved item(s) pass every check; nothing was written or called, and --apply would send nothing: {reason}. An approved item is an instruction for a person to carry out by hand
meaning_zh: 试运行：{total} 个已批准项中有 {go} 个通过所有检查；未写入也未调用任何接口，而且加 --apply 也不会发送：{reason}。已批准的项目是一条由人手动执行的指示

meaning_en: this harness's allowlist is empty: it may write nothing to the external system
meaning_zh: 这个工具的允许清单是空的：不能向外部系统写入任何内容

meaning_en: sent the go items of {total} approved item(s): {confirmed} confirmed, {failed} failed, {unknown} unknown, {skipped} not sent
meaning_zh: 已处理 {total} 个已批准项：{confirmed} 个已确认，{failed} 个失败，{unknown} 个结果不明，{skipped} 个未发送

meaning_en: another execute run holds {lock}; nothing was written
meaning_zh: 另一个执行进程正在运行（{lock}）；未写入任何内容

meaning_en: #{id}: its latest effect is {state}, not sent or unknown; nothing to reconcile
meaning_zh: #{id}：最新的执行状态是 {state}，不是已发送或不明，无需核对

meaning_en: #{id}: the read-back cannot tell whether it was written; it stays blocked. Check the target by hand
meaning_zh: #{id}：回读仍无法判断是否已写入，目标继续锁定。请人工检查

meaning_en: #{id}: read back, {state}; its target is no longer blocked
meaning_zh: #{id}：已回读，结果为 {state}；目标已解除锁定

meaning_en: #{id} {kind} on {target_ref}: this harness has no executor for it yet
meaning_zh: #{id} {target_ref} 的 {kind}：这个工具还没有执行它的程序
